verdict.rationale: Swell documents stock adjustments for tracking inventory changes over time and real-time inventory tracking per variant, which covers the stock-adjustment part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows multiple locations or warehouse-based fulfillment routing, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: multi-location/warehouse inventory tracking, fulfillment routing from the correct warehouse, per-location stock levels, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, inventory tracks across multiple locations with stock adjustments and fulfillment from the right warehouse

citations.quote: Stock adjustments are used to keep track of inventory changes over time.
Track inventory of each variant in real-time.
